explication: OpenEnv is a framework for creating and interacting with isolated agentic execution environments through Gymnasium-style reset, step, and state operations. The main runtime flow is an agent client sending actions to a server, which delegates them to environment logic and returns observations; the shared server layer manages sessions and protocol handling. The repository also includes environment discovery/creation and a CLI for environment lifecycle tasks. The README documents provider and web-interface capabilities; source excerpts are incomplete, so uncertain implementation links are omitted.
